# Ajeet Singh (CreativSingh) — Portfolio & System Overview

> Product Designer, Design Engineer & Community Builder based in Delhi, India.

## Summary

Ajeet Singh (CreativSingh) is a Lead Product Designer & Design Engineer who designs & builds digital products, leads design communities, and mentors designers across India.

- **Name**: Ajeet Singh
- **Brand**: CreativSingh
- **Location**: Delhi, India
- **Website**: https://creativsingh.com
- **Role**: Lead Product Designer & Design Engineer
- **Community**: Founder at PixelPeps (2,000+ members)

## Core Capabilities & Specializations

- **Product Design**: Enterprise SaaS, AI-assisted workflows, multi-sided platforms, complex system design, and information architecture.
- **Design Engineering**: Translating UI/UX design systems into production-ready React, Next.js, and TypeScript frontend components.
- **Community Leadership**: Building & scaling design communities, facilitating workshops, and mentoring designers.

## Selected Case Studies & Work

- [Scalie](https://creativsingh.com/work/scalie): Enterprise Resource Management Platform replacing spreadsheet-driven operations with a centralized workspace across Vendor, Client, and Admin panels.
- [Commudle](https://creativsingh.com/work/commudle): All-in-one community management and tech event hosting platform serving 120K+ event attendees.
- [Prana AI](https://creativsingh.com/work/prana-ai): AI-powered health & wellness platform transforming biometric telemetry data into personalized daily action guidance.
- [Hunger Express](https://creativsingh.com/work/hunger-express): Multi-sided food delivery ecosystem for the Nigerian market spanning Customer, Delivery Partner, and Vendor mobile apps.
- [Genesis AI](https://creativsingh.com/work/genesis-ai): Enterprise CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) AI-assisted rule configurator.

## Community & Speaking

- [PixelPeps Community](https://creativsingh.com/pixelpeps): Design community focused on peer crits, mentorship, design systems, and workshops.
- [Public Speaking & Talks](https://creativsingh.com/speaking): 20+ talks and workshops delivered across India on Product Design, UI/UX, and Design Engineering.

## Core Tech & Tools Stack

- **Design**: Figma, Miro, Lottie, Adobe Creative Suite, Design Systems, Wireframing.
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3, Git.
